DLMS-015.name: Confusion-Pair Detection
behavior: Detects repeated incorrect answer-choice selections that occur in place of a correct choice.
Requires at least 2 occurrences before a confusion pair is surfaced.
Aggregates across Study and Exam learning events using the existing deduplication semantics.
Does not force matching or hotspot responses into a choice-based confusion model.
Groups Smart Review and Spaced Review copies with identical source-question text.

DLMS-016.name: Question Quality Analytics
behavior: Shows evidence count, accuracy, concepts, and review signals per logical question.
Requires 5 deduplicated responses for general quality classification.
Flags high miss rate / very difficult patterns without declaring the question invalid.
Flags very easy questions with enough evidence.
Flags strong distractors and unused distractors after at least 8 responses.
Treats all signals as author review prompts rather than automatic judgments.
